name: Blink Video Doorbell 2nd Gen (UK)

radios.note: Blink's spec page and FAQ list 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n only. Blink lists model BDM01300U for the UK and several EU countries.

matter.note: No Matter claim on Blink's UK pages, and no CSA listing for this doorbell surfaced in search.

apple_home.note: Blink's UK FAQ mentions Siri Shortcuts but not HomeKit or Apple Home, so Apple Home support is not confirmed.

google_home.note: Blink's UK pages for this model don't mention Google Home.

alexa.note: Blink's UK FAQ says you can link Blink and Alexa accounts, and two-way audio works on Alexa devices such as the Echo Show. Compatible Alexa devices can also act as a chime.

smartthings.note: No official Blink or SmartThings page found.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page names this doorbell.

hubRequired.note: Blink's 2nd Gen FAQ, setup guide, spec page and Sync Module table say it requires a Sync Module. The Sync Module Core FAQ lists an unnamed-generation Video Doorbell as optional; Amazon UK calls the Core an optional bundle.

localControl.note: Blink does not state whether any control works without its cloud.

cameraType.note: Battery doorbell, IP65 weather resistant, with optional wiring to an existing chime.

power.note: Batteries are needed even when wired to the chime. Blink quotes up to two years of battery life on default settings.

localStorage.note: Only with a Sync Module 2 (USB drive) or Sync Module XR (microSD), both sold separately. The Sync Module Core in the bundle supports cloud storage only.

subscription.value: Cloud clip storage and person detection (Blink plan)
subscription.note: UK cloud retention is 30 days (60 elsewhere). A 30-day Plus trial is included; Amazon UK says Person Detection needs a plan.

summary: Only Alexa is confirmed for Blink's Video Doorbell (2nd Gen, BDM01300U) in the UK: link your accounts and two-way audio works on devices like the Echo Show. The doorbell runs on three AA lithium batteries, with optional chime wiring, and needs a Sync Module; the UK bundle includes a Sync Module Core. Cloud clips are kept for 30 days with a Blink plan. Apple Home, Google Home and Home Assistant are not confirmed.
caveats: Local storage needs a Sync Module 2 or XR, sold separately; the bundled Sync Module Core stores in the cloud only.
Cloud storage and person detection need a Blink subscription; UK retention is 30 days.
Apple Home, Google Home and Home Assistant support is not confirmed.
